name: Enja Yuuga
source:
“There’s no way I can tell you that I can’t live without you”

Occupation: Actor • Talent

Kill or spare as you please

A young actor at the peak of his popularity. He made his debut in the entertainment industry after he was scouted in high school. At the time he was very reluctant to enter that glamorous world, but his family pushed him to do so. He's an unusually hard worker, always disciplined in the belief that his public face must always be perfect. He has an older and a younger sister, because of his history of being told what to do by them he's actually not very confident in himself. But because the Enja Yuuga who appears on TV seems smart and flamboyant, he forces himself to continue that act, and his mentality is very much in jeopardy.

   He was stalked by an obsessed fan in the past, and although his mental health was severely damaged, he managed to recover. He has no connection with women in any way and is very uncomfortable with women in his private life.
